originalMetadata.title: How to think like a Genius ( even if you know nothing )
originalMetadata.description:
What separates geniuses from average thinkers? In this video, you'll learn how to rewire your brain to think deeper, faster, and more creatively — like the smartest minds in history. Whether you're a student, entrepreneur, or a curious mind, this mindset will change how you approach every problem.
